findings.title: Consume recovery codes and test their one-time-use lifecycle
findings.body: The new recovery-code validator accepts any code in the original list without removing or marking it used, and getCredentials() reconstructs a fresh credential from that unchanged list on every call. Consequently, the same recovery code can authenticate indefinitely, the login form always requests the first code, and exhaustion never triggers replacement. The new integration test only performs one login, so it passes despite these violations of the recovery-code contract. Make the test provider persist consumption and extend the test to verify rejection of a reused code, progression to the next code, and replacement after exhaustion.
